extraRecovery.description: This institution interrupts the first console load of each session with a scheduled-maintenance notice that must be acknowledged before the search screen appears. It is informational only.

target.description: Acknowledge button on the system notice

notes: Scoped to one capability because step overrides are keyed by step id, and step ids belong to a recording. A tenant-wide file cannot hold them without going stale the moment any one capability is re-recorded — which is exactly how this tenant ran for a while with its reworded button and relabelled field silently un-overridden.

target.description: Member Number field in the Member Search panel

evidence.textSnippet: This tenant labels the field 'Member Number'. As with the search button, an identically-labelled field exists in the Recent Terminal Activity panel, so the container anchor is still load-bearing.

target.description: Find Member button in the Member Search panel

evidence.textSnippet: This tenant's build labels the search action 'Find Member' rather than 'Search'. Wording differences in an accessible name cannot be absorbed by fuzzy matching without making every button match every other, so this is an explicit override.
